versions.content: For transmissions the Ethernet Controller shall enable hardware capabilities for the calculation of protocol checksums (offloading) according to the following list: a) for IPv4 frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadCheck sumIPv4 is set to TRUE b) for ICMP frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumICMP is set to TRUE c) for TCP frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumTCP is set to TRUE d) for UDP frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumUDP is set to TRUE. In all other cases, the Et hernet Controller shall not manipulate the checksum fields.
